manifest.name: dsh-model-selector
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness model selector upgrade: one-level model & reasoning-effort picker with 5 Liang tiers, custom model aliases, and peak/off-peak price countdown.
manifest.author: DeepVite <ibronfree@gmail.com>

bundle.text:
# dsh-model-selector bundle patch: mounts the plugin into a profile layer stack.
# Runtime defaults live at the plugin's config boundary. Users override them in
# their profile patch row with the same id.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-model-selector
      name: 'dsh-model-selector'

readme.text:
> 梁文谷插件 · DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器升级
>
> Liang Valley plugin · Model selector upgrade for DeepSeek Harness

**中文**  |  [English](README.en.md)

---

**DSH（DeepSeek Harness）模型选择与推理档位插件的增强版：把模型选择、思考档位、时段计价提示整合到一个按钮里，一键安装、点开即用。**

**An enhanced model-selector and reasoning-effort plugin for DSH (DeepSeek Harness): model picking, thinking tiers, and peak/off-peak pricing hints unified into one button. One-command install, open and go.**

---

readme.section: 1. 一级菜单快速选择【模型】与【思考档位】
readme.text:
- 优化 DSH 原生模型选择的二级菜单体验，打开后直接在一级菜单点选模型
- 选中的模型下方直接内嵌 **5 档推理强度滑条**：

| 档位 | 对应 DeepSeek 思考强度 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 小难梁 | `off` | 关闭思考 |
| 梁子 | `low` | 低强度 |
| 梁文锋 | `high` | 高强度（DeepSeek 默认档） |
| 梁圣 | `max` | 最大强度 |
| 梁神 | — | 占位展示，不可选中 |

- 在模型列表中直接点"编辑"即可给任何模型设置**简称**（如把 `deepseek-v4-pro` 显示为 `D-Pro`）
- 名称保存在本地，重启不丢失

readme.section: 3. 低谷基价提示与倒计时
readme.text:
- 模型选择按钮左侧的状态点实时显示当前时段：
  - 🟡 **梁文锋** = 高峰时段 · 全价
  - 🟢 **梁文谷** = 低谷时段 · 半价
- 点击按钮弹出的面板顶部显示**距下一状态的倒计时**（高峰→低谷绿色倒计时 / 低谷→高峰黄色倒计时）
- 时段规则：**周一至周五 9:00-12:00、14:00-18:00 为高峰**（北京时间），其余为低谷

---

要求：已安装 DSH 且使用 web profile。

```bash
npm exec -- dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-model-selector

npm exec -- dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/DeepVite/dsh-model-selector.git
```

安装后**刷新浏览器**即可看到效果。若 git 安装提示 pnpm 拦截构建脚本，按提示把包名加入 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 的 `allowBuilds` 后再试。

```bash
npm exec -- dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-model-selector
```

---

打开模型选择按钮即可看到：状态点（黄=高峰/绿=低谷）、模型列表（可编辑别名）、选中模型下方的 5 档滑条、顶部时段倒计时。

---

- [ ] 设置指令等待至低谷计价后发送，以节省 token 消耗，并设置计算机不进入休眠

readme.section: 1. One-level menu: pick 【model】 and 【thinking tier】 fast
readme.text:
- Replaces DSH's stock two-level model menu: everything is on one level
- The selected model embeds a **5-tier reasoning slider** directly below it:

| Tier | DeepSeek effort | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| 小难梁 | `off` | thinking disabled |
| 梁子 | `low` | low |
| 梁文锋 | `high` | high (DeepSeek default) |
| 梁圣 | `max` | maximum |
| 梁神 | — | placeholder, not selectable |

- Click "编辑" (Edit) on any model in the list to set a **short name** (e.g. `deepseek-v4-pro` → `D-Pro`)
- Stored locally, survives restarts

- The state dot on the left of the trigger button shows the current phase in real time:
  - 🟡 **梁文锋** = peak hours · full price
  - 🟢 **梁文谷** = off-peak hours · half price
- The panel (opened by clicking the button) shows a **countdown to the next phase** on top (peak→off-peak counts down in green; off-peak→peak in yellow)
- Phase rules: **Mon–Fri 9:00–12:00 & 14:00–18:00 are peak** (Beijing time); everything else is off-peak

---

Requires DSH with a web profile.

```bash
npm exec -- dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-model-selector

npm exec -- dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/DeepVite/dsh-model-selector.git
```

Then **refresh the browser**. If a git install is blocked by pnpm's build-script guard, add the printed package key under `allowBuilds` in the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and re-run.

```bash
npm exec -- dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-model-selector
```
